summary: Learn benchmark design, fiscal cost estimation, and tax expenditure reporting. Explore the course and build practical policy-analysis skills.
lede: Tax expenditure analysis identifies tax provisions that depart from a benchmark system and assesses their fiscal costs and effects. Designed for budget analysts, revenue officials and public-finance advisers, the course covers building an inventory, estimating costs with revenue-foregone and outlay-equivalence methods, assessing distributional effects, and presenting uncertainty and findings for budget review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who identify or assess tax provisions, prepare budget analysis, or scrutinize public revenue policy. It suits intermediate practitioners who can relate tax policy or public budgeting concepts to their work.
audience: Ministry of finance tax policy officials
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public budgeting, tax policy, or revenue administration is recommended. No programming is required. Basic spreadsheet skills will help with the estimation exercises.
